note: Synthetic OSINT corpus for the investigator evidence-gathering loop (Phase 65; deepened Phase 66). FICTIONAL registry / adverse-media / sanctions records, keyed to the SYNTHETIC display identities the workbench lays over the (label-blind) aml-substrate population. NO real persons, companies, sanctions designations, or news. Every record is illustrative demo data. The agent loop may only surface findings whose verbatim quote grounds (locate_span) as a substring of one of THESE records' text — the gate proves a finding is anchored to this synthetic corpus, never that the finding is true. Phase 66: registry records carry `relationships:[{src,dst,label,ownership_pct}]` MIRRORING aml-substrate's RelationshipEdge schema (BENEFICIAL_OWNER / DIRECTOR_OF / OFFICER_OF / CONTROLS / OWNS) so this local network view is the rendering PROTOTYPE for the substrate's emitted beneficial-owner graph (docs/substrate-bo-graph-emission-PLAN-BRIEF.md). Designed to demonstrate: chained discoveries (a subject's ownership link exposes an affiliate a sanctions screen then flags), cross-subject ownership links, and honest-empty results for clean subjects. The relationship label is vocab-checked, ownership_pct range-checked — neither is correctness-checked.
